project.title: Ride Slowly, Ride Safely

execution_policy.successful_terminal_requirement: Verified completed export record in My Videos

v2_generation_policy.single_visible_character_rule: Map the sole visible character to Actor 1 regardless of that character's mapping in other shots.
v2_generation_policy.initial_batch_rule: Submit five video jobs continuously before opening the monitoring tab.
v2_generation_policy.refill_rule: Submit all freed-slot replacements continuously before returning to monitoring.
v2_generation_policy.ten_second_example: 10 seconds generation - 2 seconds reserve = 8 seconds speech = maximum 12 words
v2_generation_policy.actor_script_content_rule: Exact spoken words only. No quotation marks, speaker labels, voice directions, emotion directions, timing notes, or camera directions.
v2_generation_policy.video_prompt_content_rule: Actor mapping, positions, clothing, actions, reactions, camera, environment, and visible speaking behavior only. Never include the exact spoken sentence.

voice_workflow.source_clip_policy: S01 is the first recurring character's canonical voice source; S02 is the second recurring character's canonical voice source.
voice_workflow.source_clip_requirement: Each source clip has exactly one speaking character, one populated actor-script field, no background or overlapping speech, and at least two seconds of clean soft slow-English speech.
voice_workflow.source_clip_failure_rule: Regenerate the same S01 or S02 source shot with the same character mapping; do not substitute a later shot or the other character's voice.
voice_workflow.save_method: Right-click source clip > Save Audio > save to My AI Audio with stable character-specific name
voice_workflow.source_clip_rule: Preserve S01 and S02 original canonical voices; record canonical_source_preserved instead of applying each sample to itself.
voice_workflow.one_speaker_clip_rule: For every eligible S03+ clip, right-click the timeline clip, choose Voice Changer, select the mapped stable voice asset from My AI Audio, click Apply, and verify the replacement result.
voice_workflow.two_speaker_clip_rule: For every eligible S03+ two-speaker clip, split at the speaker-change boundary and apply each mapped character voice only to that speaker's segment; never apply one voice to an unsplit two-speaker clip.
voice_workflow.unsplittable_two_speaker_rule: Skip Voice Changer and preserve generated voices rather than applying the wrong character voice.

timeline_plan.primary_insertion_method: Media Library > My AI Videos > right-click clip > Add to Timeline
recovery_order: Read saved tab IDs, inserted shots, and next_timeline_shot_id from WORKFLOW_STATE.json
Reacquire the saved settings tab or the visible VideoExpress editor tab
Reopen Media Library > My AI Videos
Re-identify the next missing clip by video_job_id
Retry browser-native right-click > Add to Timeline once
Reopen My AI Videos and retry once
Reload only the settings tab, restore state, and retry once
After success continue remaining clips and Auto Align pass 1 without stopping
